issue: Procedure slots are draft inventory/setup-card templates, not clinical checklists.
recommended_action: Assign clinician, nursing/RT, anesthesia, SPD, infection-control, laboratory, homecare, and supply-chain owners to approve each relevant procedure template.

issue: Role matching alone does not guarantee device-platform compatibility.
recommended_action: Implement hard compatibility filters using current IFUs for working channel, scope hub, barrel ID, guidewire, energy generator, cable, stent applicator, trocar, and IPC system.

issue: The catalog includes manufacturer documents ranging from 2011 through 2026; commercial availability, current IFUs, UDI records, FDA status, recalls, and discontinuations were not comprehensively reverified.
